outcome: Maternal complications (e.g., threatened preterm labor, blood transfusion, postpartum hemorrhage)
Fetal outcomes (e.g., low APGAR score, need for resuscitation, low birth weight, stillbirth)
cohort: 38 pregnant women with uterine fibroids detected prenatally or antenatally by ultrasound.
finding: Pregnancies with fibroids were associated with a higher risk of Cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and various antepartum, intrapartum, and postpartum complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most frequent mode of delivery.
gest_age: Deliveries were most common between 38 and 40 weeks.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in some cases (5.26%).
